part.text:
Done. The fix normalizes the `content-encoding` header value to lowercase before decompression matching in lib/adapters/http.js:192-195:

```js
const normalizedContentEncoding = String(contentEncoding || '').trim().toLowerCase();
const encodingToken = encodingAliases[normalizedContentEncoding] || normalizedContentEncoding;
```

Verification:
- All 31 decompression tests pass, including the `GZIP` (uppercase) case that previously failed.
- Full unit suite: 151 passing, only 5 pre-existing environment-related failures (HTTPS/DNS/maxContentLength), which I confirmed fail identically with my change stashed.
